the west virginia university foundation will serve as fiscal sponsor for this project. this funding will enable west virginia family nutrition program (wv fnp) to partner with marshall university's nutrition education program in huntington, wv, to pilot the healthy habitz program in cabell county. this program will provide expanded access to produce, education, and clinical support to families of children identified as at risk for diabetes, who will receive produce prescriptions and be provided tokens for kids market @ the store programs at the wild ramp and unlimited future. registered dietitians will provide tailored, nutrition guidance for participant families and families will be invited to participate in walking and water challenges and connect with additional community resources and supports. faith health appalachia (fha) will provide leadership coaching to cabell county family resource network (ccfrn)'s new director and board assessments for its new board members. second, the ccfrn will implement the tooth buddies project, which will introduce proper oral hygiene habits to 600 children in child care centers across cabell county. last, fha will build the capacity of its faith community nursing program by increasing its program coordinator's time dedicated to the program and supporting costs associated with fha's electronic medical record system. big brothers big sisters of the tri-state will recruit volunteer mentors and provide mentor/mentee match activities. funds will support staff travel expenses, outreach tabling, and informational meetings with potential volunteer partners, as well as monthly social events for mentors and mentees. the marshall university research corporation will use funding to support the marshall university center of excellence for recovery and its prevention empowerment partnership. college-age students enrolled in a workforce development prevention trainee project will complete a substance use prevention leadership program and receive training on the principles of evidence-based substance use prevention, leadership, peer-to-peer teaching, mentoring, entrepreneurship, and community coalition building. trainees will then work directly with youth in local schools and summer and after-school programming. the salvation army of kentucky and tennessee will purchase healthy food for weekend meals and snacks served at its ashland, ky, shelter. williamson health and wellness center will use funds for the response to the february 2025 flooding in mingo county, wv and pike county, ky. funds will be used to enhance whwc's mobile unit by purchasing a scanner and refrigerator. funds also will be used for food, hygiene, cleaning, and medical supplies. finally, funds will be used to reimburse whwc staff for transportation costs associated with transporting flood aid to residences. pike county health department's will contract with a university of pikeville faculty dentist to provide preventive
